localizedValues.name: C1
localizedValues.description: The cabins at Pearrygin Lake are located in the West Campground and have the added convenience of kitchenettes with microwave, coffee maker, small refrigerator, sink and a two burner ceramic cooktop. Each cabin has electric heat and air conditioning, lights, locking door and bathroom with a toilet. Showers are nearby in the park. Each cabin is 16-by-16 feet in size and is furnished with a full-size bed, two person sliding day bed, and small table with chairs and can sleep a maximum of four people. Outside is a picnic table, fire pit and a deck.
